summary: Police have increased security in provinces bordering Cambodia to ensure safety for advance voting scheduled for February 2. Assistant National Police Chief Pol Lt-Gen Yingyos Thepchamnong stated that they do not expect violence to disrupt the election process but are remaining vigilant at all polling stations.

title: Security Tightened at Border Ahead of Advance Voting

summary: The Cambodian State Secretariat of Border Affairs has issued a formal protest against the Thai military for allegedly clearing homes of Cambodian citizens in disputed areas. Cambodia is urging Thailand to resume joint survey activities between February 9 and 13, 2026, and stated it will not recognize any boundary changes resulting from the use of force. This follows a period of heavy fighting in 2025 that displaced over 500,000 people.

summaryTh: สำนักงานเลขาธิการคณะกรรมการชายแดนกัมพูชา ยื่นหนังสือประท้วงกองทัพไทยกรณีทำลายที่พักอาศัยของชาวกัมพูชาในพื้นที่ทับซ้อน โดยเรียกร้องให้ไทยกลับมาเจรจาปักปันเขตแดนในช่วงวันที่ 9-13 กุมภาพันธ์ 2569 พร้อมประกาศไม่ยอมรับการเปลี่ยนแปลงแนวเขตแดนที่เกิดจากการใช้กำลัง หลังเกิดการปะทะรุนแรงในปี 2568 ที่ทำให้ประชาชนกว่า 5 แสนคนต้องอพยพ

summary: Thai Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow stated that the military is monitoring Cambodian troop movements and weapon repositioning. He emphasized that while Thailand seeks peace, it is fully prepared to defend its territory if there is intentional provocation or further encroachment. He also warned Cambodia to be careful with rhetoric that interferes with Thai affairs.

summary: Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow warned Cambodia against escalation following a Friday night incident at Phu Pha Lek, Si Sa Ket. Cambodian troops reportedly triggered a flare alarm, leading the Thai military to fire a warning shell. Shortly after, an M79 grenade exploded in the area. Thailand is closely monitoring troop and weapon movements while emphasizing commitment to the ceasefire.
summaryKh: រដ្ឋមន្ត្រីការបរទេសលោក Sihasak Phuangketkeow បានព្រមានកម្ពុជាកុំឱ្យបង្កើនភាពតានតឹង បន្ទាប់ពីមានហេតុការណ៍កាលពីយប់ថ្ងៃសុក្រនៅភូផាឡិក ខេត្តស៊ីសាកេត។ កងទ័ពកម្ពុជាត្រូវបានរាយការណ៍ថាបានធ្វើឱ្យសញ្ញាគ្រាប់រំសេវឆេះឡើង ដែលនាំឱ្យយោធាថៃបាញ់គ្រាប់កាំភ្លើងព្រមាន។ បន្ទាប់មក គ្រាប់បែក M79 បានផ្ទុះនៅក្នុងតំបន់នោះ។ ថៃកំពុងតាមដានយ៉ាងយកចិត្តទុកដាក់លើការផ្លាស់ទីទ័ព និងអាវុធ។
summaryTh: นายสีหศักดิ์ พวงเกตุแก้ว รมว.ต่างประเทศ เตือนกัมพูชาให้หลีกเลี่ยงการขยายความขัดแย้งหลังเกิดเหตุที่ภูผาเหล็ก จ.ศรีสะเกษ เมื่อคืนวันศุกร์ โดยทหารกัมพูชาได้ทำให้สัญญาณพลุไฟดังขึ้น ทำให้ทหารไทยยิงกระสุนเตือน และหลังจากนั้นไม่นานมีระเบิด M79 ตกในพื้นที่ ไทยยืนยันว่ากำลังเฝ้าติดตามการเคลื่อนย้ายกำลังพลและอาวุธอย่างใกล้ชิด

summary: Thai Army Region 2 and Cambodian Military Region 4 met at Chong Sa-ngam, Si Sa Ket, agreeing on six points: following the GBC's peaceful conflict resolution, preventing misunderstandings, adhering to JBC mechanisms for boundary issues, warning of landmines due to forest fires, encouraging citizens to trust official news, and holding monthly meetings to maintain peace.
summaryKh: កងទ័ពភូមិភាគទី 2 ថៃ និងយោធភូមិភាគទី 4 កម្ពុជា បានជួបប្រជុំគ្នានៅច្រាំងសងាំ ខេត្តស៊ីសាកេត ដោយបានព្រមព្រៀងគ្នាលើចំណុចចំនួន 6 រួមមាន៖ ការអនុវត្តតាមក្របខ័ណ្ឌ GBC ដើម្បីដោះស្រាយជម្លោះដោយសន្តិវិធី ការការពារការយល់ច្រឡំ ការប្រកាន់ខ្ជាប់នូវយន្តការ JBC សម្រាប់បញ្ហាព្រំដែន ការព្រមានអំពីគ្រាប់មីនដោយសារភ្លើងឆេះព្រៃ ការលើកទឹកចិត្តប្រជាពលរដ្ឋឱ្យជឿជាក់លើព័ត៌មានផ្លូវការ និងការរៀបចំកិច្ចប្រជុំប្រចាំខែដើម្បីរក្សាសន្តិភាព។
summaryTh: กองทัพภาคที่ 2 และภูมิภาคทหารที่ 4 กัมพูชา ประชุมร่วมกันที่ช่องสะงำ จ.ศรีสะเกษ ได้ข้อสรุป 6 ประการ ได้แก่ ยึดกรอบ GBC แก้ปัญหาโดยสันติ, ป้องกันการเข้าใจผิด, ใช้กลไก JBC เรื่องเส้นเขตแดน, เฝ้าระวังทุ่นระเบิดจากไฟป่า, ขอให้ประชาชนเชื่อข่าวราชการ และนัดพบปะกันเดือนละครั้งเพื่อรักษาความสงบ

summary: Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow stated that while dialogue channels remain open, the Thai military is prepared to defend sovereignty if there is deliberate provocation. This follows reports of shots crossing into Thailand on Jan 30. He emphasized the need for a sustainable ceasefire ahead of the Feb 8 Thai election and warned against interfering remarks.
summaryKh: រដ្ឋមន្ត្រីការបរទេសលោក Sihasak Phuangketkeow បានថ្លែងថា ទោះបីជាបណ្តាញសន្ទនានៅតែបើកចំហ ប៉ុន្តែយោធាថៃបានត្រៀមខ្លួនរួចជាស្រេចដើម្បីការពារអធិបតេយ្យភាព ប្រសិនបើមានការបង្កហេតុដោយចេតនា។ នេះធ្វើឡើងបន្ទាប់ពីមានសេចក្តីរាយការណ៍អំពីការបាញ់បោះឆ្លងចូលក្នុងទឹកដីថៃកាលពីថ្ងៃទី 30 ខែមករា។ លោកបានសង្កត់ធ្ងន់លើតម្រូវការសម្រាប់បទឈប់បាញ់ប្រកបដោយនិរន្តរភាព មុនការបោះឆ្នោតថៃនៅថ្ងៃទី 8 ខែកុម្ភៈ និងបានព្រមានប្រឆាំងនឹងការលើកឡើងដែល mangលក្ខណៈជ្រៀតជ្រែក។
summaryTh: นายสีหศักดิ์ พวงเกตุแก้ว รมว.ต่างประเทศ ระบุว่าช่องทางเจรจายังเปิดอยู่ แต่กองทัพไทยพร้อมปกป้องอธิปไตยหากมีการจงใจยั่วยุ หลังมีรายงานกระสุนตกฝั่งไทยเมื่อวันที่ 30 ม.ค. พร้อมเน้นย้ำความสำคัญของการหยุดยิงที่ยั่งยืนก่อนการเลือกตั้งไทยวันที่ 8 ก.พ. นี้ และเตือนเรื่องการใช้ถ้อยคำที่อาจเป็นการแทรกแซง

summary: Thai officials are calling for calm as border tensions persist before the general election. Despite reports of small arms fire and explosions, the Foreign Minister emphasized that many incidents are misunderstandings. Security forces are monitoring reported Cambodian troop buildups and trench digging near the border.
summaryTh: เจ้าหน้าที่ไทยเรียกร้องความสงบท่ามกลางความตึงเครียดชายแดนก่อนการเลือกตั้งทั่วไป แม้จะมีรายงานเสียงปืนและระเบิด แต่ รมว.ต่างประเทศ ย้ำว่าเป็นความเข้าใจผิดในหลายกรณี ขณะที่หน่วยความมั่นคงกำลังเฝ้าติดตามการเสริมกำลังทหารและการขุดสนามเพลาะของกัมพูชาใกล้ชายแดน
title: Thailand pushes for ceasefire amid Cambodia border tensions

summary: Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow dismissed claims by Cambodian PM Hun Manet that Thailand is 'invading' Cambodian territory. Sihasak stated that Thai actions are strictly for protecting national sovereignty and not aggression. He suggested that such rhetoric from Phnom Penh might be driven by domestic political necessity or falling popularity within Cambodia.

summary: The Cambodian Ministry of Foreign Affairs has issued a formal protest against Thailand regarding a field visit on February 2. Cambodia claims the area is under illegal Thai military occupation following clashes in December 2025 and views the visit as a violation of sovereignty.

summary: The Royal Thai Army (RTA) has officially rejected a protest from Cambodia's Ministry of Foreign Affairs regarding a Thai-led visit by foreign military attachés to hotels in O Smach on February 2. RTA spokesperson Maj. Gen. Winthai Suvaree stated that the area is currently under Thai control as per the December 27 Joint Statement, which froze troop positions. summary: A special meeting of the Thai-Cambodian Regional Border Committee (RBC) held in Trat from February 3-5 ended prematurely on February 4 without an agreement. Thailand maintains that the meeting's sole purpose was to maintain communication and prevent further clashes, but no consensus could be reached due to Cambodia's demands.

summary: A special Regional Border Committee (RBC) meeting in Trat province ended without a joint conclusion. Rear Admiral Parat Rattanachaiphan stated that while Thailand sought to maintain communication and a sustainable ceasefire, Cambodia introduced boundary demarcation proposals that fell outside the agreed General Border Committee (GBC) framework from December 27. Thailand rejected these proposals as inconsistent with existing agreements, leading to a stalemate.

summary: Border tensions are peaking in Sa Kaeo province as Thai security forces monitor 24/7 surveillance. Local Thai villagers in Khok Sung district are reportedly living in fear, unable to work in fields, and are calling on the government to clarify the border line and increase protection as the election draws near.

summary: Army Region 2 reported that on Feb 5 at 10:20 AM, a 40mm grenade was fired from the Cambodian side, landing near a Thai military base in Kantharalak, Sisaket. No injuries were reported. Cambodian commanders claimed the incident was caused by a 'lack of discipline' from newly stationed troops and have issued warnings to their personnel.
summaryTh: กองทัพภาคที่ 2 รายงานว่าเมื่อวันที่ 5 ก.พ. เวลา 10.20 น. มีการยิงลูกระเบิดขนาด 40 มม. จากฝั่งกัมพูชามาตกใกล้ฐานปฏิบัติการไทยใน อ.กันทรลักษ์ จ.ศรีสะเกษ ไม่มีผู้บาดเจ็บ ฝ่ายกัมพูชาอ้างว่าเป็นความไร้วินัยของกำลังพลชุดใหม่และได้ทำการตักเตือนแล้ว

summary: Government spokesperson Traisuree Taisaranakul clarified that reports of a military clash at Phan Lan Hin Paed Kon in Sisaket are incorrect. She stated that a bushfire reached a Cambodian landmine/explosive near the frontline, causing a 40mm explosion. No Thai troops were injured. She urged Cambodia to urgently manage their explosives to prevent further misunderstandings during the fragile ceasefire.

summary: A special session of the Regional Border Committee (RBC) in Trat province concluded without reaching any agreements or a joint summary. The Royal Thai Navy spokesperson stated that Thailand rejected Cambodian proposals regarding border demarcation, as they fell outside the committee's scope and contradicted previous joint statements. The meeting aimed to maintain a sustainable ceasefire following the December 2025 conflict.

summary: The Burapha Force has established full security control over Ban Khlong Phaeng in Sa Kaeo province. Colonel Pathompon Wongpidej reported that the military has demolished over 389 Cambodian structures that had encroached into the disputed zone near Border Marker 36. Meanwhile, local Thai residents whose homes were destroyed in previous 2025 clashes are weeping and pleading for government compensation as promised by the PM.

summary: The Royal Thai Army, via spokesperson Maj. Gen. Winthai Suvaree, rejected a protest note from Cambodia regarding an alleged unauthorized entry into O'Smach on Feb 2. The Army clarified the area has been under Thai control since the Dec 27, 2025 ceasefire agreement. During security checks, Thai forces discovered evidence of cyber scam operations in nearby casino buildings. The Thai side maintains that their presence is consistent with the GBC joint statement to combat transnational crime.

summary: The Regional Border Committee (RBC) meeting between Thailand's Chanthaburi-Trat Border Defense Command and Cambodia's Military Region Three ended without an agreement. Despite being scheduled for February 3-5, the talks concluded early with no joint summary. Thai Navy spokesperson Rear Admiral Parat Rattanachaiphan stated that while Thailand wanted to maintain communication and the ceasefire, Cambodia proposed demarcation issues that fell outside the scope of the RBC and contradicted previous joint statements.

summary: Cambodian PM Hun Manet has written to French President Emmanuel Macron requesting historical and technical documents from the 1907 colonial era. The move aims to provide legal backing for Cambodia's territorial claims following two major military conflicts in 2025 that killed over 140 people and displaced half a million civilians on both sides.
summaryKh: នាយករដ្ឋមន្ត្រីកម្ពុជា លោក ហ៊ុន ម៉ាណែត បានសរសេរលិខិតទៅកាន់ប្រធានាធិបតីបារាំង លោក Emmanuel Macron ដើម្បីស្នើសុំឯកសារប្រវត្តិសាស្ត្រ និងបច្ចេកទេសតាំងពីសម័យអាណានិគមឆ្នាំ 1907។ វិធានការនេះមានគោលបំណងផ្តល់ការគាំទ្រផ្នែកច្បាប់សម្រាប់ការទាមទារទឹកដីរបស់កម្ពុជា បន្ទាប់ពីមានជម្លោះយោធាធំៗចំនួនពីរក្នុងឆ្នាំ 2025 ដែលបានសម្លាប់មនុស្សជាង 140 នាក់ និងធ្វើឱ្យជនស៊ីវិលកន្លះលាននាក់ភៀសខ្លួនទាំងសងខាង។
summaryTh: นายกฯ ฮุน มาเนต แห่งกัมพูชา ส่งจดหมายถึงประธานาธิบดีเอ็มมานูเอล มาครง ของฝรั่งเศส เพื่อขอเอกสารทางประวัติศาสตร์และแผนที่ทางเทคนิคสมัยอาณานิคมปี 1907 โดยหวังใช้เป็นหลักฐานทางกฎหมายในข้อพิพาทดินแดนกับไทย หลังจากเกิดการสู้รบอย่างหนักในปี 2568 ซึ่งทำให้มีผู้เสียชีวิตกว่า 140 ราย และชาวบ้านต้องอพยพกว่า 5 แสนคน

summary: Deputy Defense Minister Lt. Gen. Adul Boonthamcharoen stated that intelligence reports show no unusual troop movements or combat preparations by Cambodia that would lead to a third round of clashes. He assured the public that the military has clear rules of engagement and will provide security for citizens during the upcoming general election on February 8.

summary: A 40mm grenade round fired by Cambodian soldiers landed near a Thai military base in Kantharalak district, Si Sa Ket province, on Thursday morning. No injuries were reported. Cambodian authorities officially apologized, citing a lack of discipline among newly deployed troops for the accidental discharge. The Royal Thai Army remains on high alert but noted the December 27 ceasefire is generally holding.

summary: Cambodian Prime Minister Hun Manet has formally requested assistance from French President Emmanuel Macron to access historical maps and technical documents from the colonial era. This move aims to clarify the international boundary markers between Thailand and Cambodia following recent military clashes. Cambodia expressed appreciation for France's support of the current ceasefire and hopes that French archives will provide a definitive legal basis for territorial claims in disputed areas.
summaryKh: នាយករដ្ឋមន្ត្រីកម្ពុជា សម្តេច ហ៊ុន ម៉ាណែត បានស្នើសុំជំនួយជាផ្លូវការពីប្រធានាធិបតីបារាំង លោក Emmanuel Macron ដើម្បីទទួលបានផែនទីប្រវត្តិសាស្ត្រ និងឯកសារបច្ចេកទេសតាំងពីសម័យអាណានិគម។ ទង្វើនេះមានគោលបំណងបញ្ជាក់អំពីបង្គោលព្រំដែនអន្តរជាតិរវាងថៃ និងកម្ពុជា បន្ទាប់ពីមានការប៉ះទង្គិចយោធានាពេលថ្មីៗនេះ។
summaryTh: นายกรัฐมนตรี ฮุน มาเนต แห่งกัมพูชา ได้ส่งจดหมายถึงประธานาธิบดี เอ็มมานูเอล มาครง ของฝรั่งเศส เพื่อขอความช่วยเหลืออย่างเป็นทางการในการเข้าถึงเอกสารทางประวัติศาสตร์และแผนที่สมัยอาณานิคม เพื่อใช้เป็นหลักฐานในการกำหนดเขตแดนไทย-กัมพูชาให้ชัดเจน หลังเกิดเหตุสู้รบตามแนวชายแดน โดยกัมพูชาหวังว่าเอกสารจากฝรั่งเศสจะช่วยแก้ปัญหาข้อพิพาททางดินแดนตามหลักกฎหมายระหว่างประเทศ

summary: Major General Winthai Suvaree, Army Spokesperson, rejected a Cambodian protest note alleging Thai military intrusion into O'Smach, Oddar Meanchey. The Thai Army clarifies that the inspected area is under Thai control following the December 2025 clashes. During security sweeps, Thai forces discovered evidence of cyber scam operations within abandoned casino complexes. The military maintains that cooperation against transnational crime is part of the bilateral Joint Statement, but Cambodia has reportedly ignored requests for joint investigations.

summaryTh: พลตรี วินธัย สุวารี โฆษกกองทัพบก ปฏิเสธหนังสือประท้วงของกัมพูชาเรื่องการล่วงละเมิดอธิปไตยในพื้นที่โอร์เสม็ด โดยระบุว่าพื้นที่ดังกล่าวเป็นเขตที่ไทยวางกำลังอยู่ตามข้อตกลงหยุดยิง และการเข้าตรวจค้นพบหลักฐานเครือข่ายคอลเซ็นเตอร์ (Cyber Scam) ในอาคารคาสิโนร้าง ซึ่งไทยเคยชวนกัมพูชาร่วมปราบปรามแล้วแต่ฝ่ายนั้นเพิกเฉย

summary: Col. Chainarong Kasi of Task Force 12 reported that Thai forces have secured full control of Ban Khlong Phaeng. During operations, the military discovered and dismantled two large buildings on Thai soil that were being used by Cambodian-based call center gangs to scam Thai citizens. The military has fortified the border with ditches and containers to prevent future encroachment and transnational crime.

summary: Army spokesperson Maj. Gen. Winthai Suvaree addressed a protest note from Cambodia regarding a visit by foreign military attaches to a hotel in O'Smach. Thailand claims the area has been under Thai control since the ceasefire on December 27, 2025. The spokesperson stated that the inspection was necessary because the location was being used as a 'Scam Center' for transnational crime. Thailand noted that it had previously invited Cambodia to joint-inspect the area to dismantle scam networks, but Cambodia had remained silent.

summary: The Royal Thai Army (RTA) issued a warning to Cambodia after a 40mm grenade was fired near a Thai military base in Kantharalak District, Sisaket. Army Region 2 reported that the incident occurred around 10:20 AM on February 5. Thai military officials characterized the act as a 'lack of discipline' by Cambodian soldiers rather than a deliberate tactical attack. No injuries or damage were reported, but Thai forces have increased security measures and warned they are ready to follow 'rules of engagement' if provoked further.

summary: The Civil Aviation Authority of Thailand (CAAT) has issued a ban on operating drones in 7 provinces bordering Cambodia, including Chiang Rai, Ubon Ratchathani, Si Sa Ket, Surin, Buriram, Sa Kaeo, and Chanthaburi. The order, effective from February 7, 2026, cites national security concerns amid ongoing border tensions. Unauthorized drone flights in these areas are strictly prohibited until further notice.

While Cambodia claims the site is a hotel seized by Thailand, the evidence suggests it functioned as a major hub for human trafficking and love scams.

summary: The Second Army Area commander, Lt Gen Weerayuth Raksilp, stated that Thai forces are fully prepared to defend sovereignty following an incident where a 40mm grenade fired by Cambodian troops landed at Pha Lan Hin Paet Kon in Si Sa Ket on Thursday. The commander noted that Thai troops are exercising restraint to avoid escalation before the February 8 general election but warned that the incidents appear to be deliberate provocations.

summary: Lieutenant General Weerayut Raksilp, Commander of the Second Army Region, stated during a press conference in Nakhon Ratchasima that Thai troops remain 100% ready to protect national sovereignty despite provocative actions by Cambodian soldiers. He emphasized that the military is not afraid of potential third, fourth, or fifth clashes. Meanwhile, the Ministry of Culture confirmed it will continue restoring Ta Kwai and Ta Muen Thom temples, asserting they are registered Thai historical sites despite Cambodian protests.

summaryTh: พลโทวีระยุทธ รักศิลป์ แม่ทัพภาคที่ 2 ยืนยันความพร้อมของกำลังทหารในการปกป้องอธิปไตย โดยระบุว่าไม่เกรงกลัวหากจะเกิดการปะทะครั้งใหม่ หลังมีภาพทหารกัมพูชาลาดตระเวนยั่วยุบริเวณแนวชายแดน ขณะที่กระทรวงวัฒนธรรมเดินหน้าบูรณะปราสาทตาควายและกลุ่มปราสาทตาเมือน โดยยืนยันว่าเป็นโบราณสถานของไทยที่ขึ้นทะเบียนถูกต้อง แม้จะมีการประท้วงจากฝ่ายกัมพูชา

summary: Thai security agencies are warning of a potential 'third round' of conflict following the 2026 general election. Intelligence suggests Cambodia has acquired advanced anti-aircraft systems to neutralize Thailand's air superiority. The border has been designated a critical security vulnerability, with Thai authorities intensifying surveillance. These reports come amid high nationalist sentiment and post-election political shifts in Bangkok.

summaryTh: ฝ่ายความมั่นคงไทยเตือนความเป็นไปได้ที่จะเกิดการปะทะ 'รอบที่ 3' หลังการเลือกตั้งทั่วไปปี 2569 โดยมีรายงานข่าวกรองระบุว่ากัมพูชาได้จัดหาอาวุธต่อสู้อากาศยานประสิทธิภาพสูงเพื่อลดความได้เปรียบทางอากาศของไทย พื้นที่ชายแดนถูกยกระดับเป็นจุดเปราะบางด้านความมั่นคงสูงสุด และมีการเพิ่มมาตรการเฝ้าระวังอย่างเข้มงวด

summary: Social activist Guntouch 'Gun Jompalang' Pongpaiboonwet led an operation in Trat province to seal off two road access points leading to areas reclaimed by Thailand. Using cranes and forklifts, supporters stacked 50 shipping containers to block entrances to resorts and shops operated by Chinese nationals. The move is intended to prevent further confrontation and clear boundary lines following recent clashes.

summary: Cambodia has issued its strongest protest against the Thai military for placing shipping containers to block roads and beginning road construction in Oddar Meanchey and Pursat provinces. The Cambodian Ministry of Foreign Affairs claims these actions violate the December 27, 2025, ceasefire agreement. The Thai Navy responded that the move is a necessary security measure following incidents where individuals tried to dismantle border fences in mid-January.

summary: Following the Feb 8 general election, the Bhumjaithai Party, led by Anutin Charnvirakul, is poised to lead the next government. Analysts suggest this may lead to a more nationalistic approach to the Cambodia border, as Bhumjaithai has previously called for the scrapping or revision of MOU 44 and rejected a 50:50 maritime resource split. This political shift could prolong the 'simmering' conflict despite the current ceasefire.
summaryKh: បន្ទាប់ពីការបោះឆ្នោតសកលថ្ងៃទី 8 ខែកុម្ភៈ គណបក្សភូមិចិត្តថៃ ដែលដឹកនាំដោយលោក អនុទិន ឆានវីរៈកូល ហាក់ដូចជានឹងដឹកនាំរដ្ឋាភិបាលបន្ទាប់។ អ្នកវិភាគយល់ថា នេះអាចនាំឱ្យមានការអនុវត្តគោលនយោបាយជាតិនិយមចំពោះព្រំដែនកម្ពុជា ដោយសារបក្សនេះធ្លាប់ទាមទារឱ្យលុបចោល MOU 44។
summaryTh: หลังการเลือกตั้ง 8 ก.พ. พรรคภูมิใจไทยมีแนวโน้มเป็นแกนนำจัดตั้งรัฐบาล นักวิเคราะห์มองว่าอาจส่งผลให้ไทยมีท่าทีที่แข็งกร้าวขึ้นต่อประเด็นชายแดนกัมพูชา เนื่องจากภูมิใจไทยเคยประกาศจุดยืนยกเลิกหรือแก้ไข MOU 44 และไม่ยอมรับส่วนแบ่งทรัพยากรทางทะเลแบบ 50:50 ซึ่งอาจทำให้ความขัดแย้งยืดเยื้อต่อไป
title: Bhumjaithai Election Lead Could Harden Thailand's Stance on MOU 44 and Border Conflict

summary: The Fine Arts Department has announced plans to continue the restoration of ancient Khmer-style temples located in the border areas, specifically Prasat Ta Kwai and the Prasat Ta Muen group. These efforts follow the stabilization of the border situation, aiming to preserve historical sites that were previously affected by military presence and conflict.

summary: Thai security officials have warned of a potential 'third round' of conflict following the February 8 general election. Intelligence suggests a build-up of heavy weaponry and advanced anti-aircraft systems on the Cambodian side, aimed at neutralizing Thailand's air superiority. Officials describe the current climate as a dangerous flashpoint that could erupt at any moment.

summary: Maj Gen Winthai Suvaree, the Royal Thai Army spokesperson, stated that Thailand has strictly complied with the December 27 ceasefire. However, he expressed concern over Cambodia's claims that Thailand is seizing territory by placing containers. He emphasized that these containers are for security and to stop illegal activities like cyber scams, urging Cambodia to focus on demining and genuine de-escalation.
summaryKh: ឧត្តមសេនីយ៍ទោ Winthai Suvaree អ្នកនាំពាក្យកងទ័ពភូមិន្ទថៃ បានថ្លែងថា ថៃបានអនុវត្តយ៉ាងខ្ជាប់ខ្ជួនតាមកិច្ចព្រមព្រៀងឈប់បាញ់ថ្ងៃទី 27 ខែធ្នូ។ ទោះជាយ៉ាងណាក៏ដោយ លោកបានសម្តែងការព្រួយបារម្ភចំពោះការចោទប្រកាន់របស់កម្ពុជាថា ថៃកំពុងរំលោភយកទឹកដីដោយការដាក់កុងតឺន័រ ដោយលោកបញ្ជាក់ថា កុងតឺន័រទាំងនេះគឺសម្រាប់សន្តិសុខ និងបញ្ឈប់សកម្មភាពខុសច្បាប់ដូចជាការបោកប្រាស់តាមអ៊ីនធឺណិត។

summary: Acting PM Anutin Charnvirakul has directed the Cabinet to prepare legal steps to cancel the 2001 Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) regarding overlapping maritime claims with Cambodia. He argues that the agreement has seen no progress for 20 years and that 'setting it to zero' will allow Thailand to negotiate from a stronger position without being tied to the 'indivisible package' rule that links border demarcation with resource sharing.
summaryKh: នាយករដ្ឋមន្ត្រីស្តីទីលោក Anutin Charnvirakul បានណែនាំឱ្យគណៈរដ្ឋមន្ត្រីរៀបចំជំហានផ្លូវច្បាប់ដើម្បីលុបចោលអនុស្សរណៈនៃការយោគយល់គ្នា (MOU) ឆ្នាំ 2001 ស្តីពីតំបន់សមុទ្រត្រួតស៊ីគ្នាជាមួយកម្ពុជា។ លោកបានអះអាងថា កិច្ចព្រមព្រៀងនេះមិនមានវឌ្ឍនភាពអស់រយៈពេល 20 ឆ្នាំមកហើយ ហើយការ 'កំណត់ទៅសូន្យ' នឹងអនុញ្ញាតឱ្យថៃចរចាពីទីតាំងដែលរឹងមាំជាងមុនដោយមិនមានការផ្សារភ្ជាប់ការខណ្ឌសីមាព្រំដែនជាមួយនឹងការចែករំលែកធនធាន។
summaryTh: นายกฯ อนุทิน สั่งการให้ ครม. เตรียมขั้นตอนยกเลิก MOU 2544 เกี่ยวกับพื้นที่ทับซ้อนทางทะเลไทย-กัมพูชา โดยระบุว่าต้อง 'เซตซีโร่' เพราะการเจรจาไม่มีความคืบหน้ามา 20 ปี เพื่อเปิดทางให้ไทยปรับกลยุทธ์การเจรจาใหม่ โดยไม่ต้องผูกมัดเรื่องเขตแดนกับการพัฒนาพื้นที่ร่วมกัน (JDA) เข้าด้วยกันตามเงื่อนไขเดิม

summary: The Royal Thai Army (RTA) summarized the situation one month after the Dec 27 ceasefire. While the border is physically calm, the RTA criticized Cambodia for continuing to spread 'one-sided information' to the public. Thailand insists it is following the Joint Statement by maintaining troop positions and clearing mines. The Army also noted that Cambodia has historically encouraged encroaching on Thai territory, which led to the recent clashes.
summaryKh: កងទ័ពភូមិន្ទថៃបានសង្ខេបស្ថានភាពមួយខែបន្ទាប់ពីបទឈប់បាញ់ថ្ងៃទី 27 ខែធ្នូ។ ទោះបីជាព្រំដែនមានភាពស្ងប់ស្ងាត់ ប៉ុន្តែកងទ័ពថៃបានរិះគន់កម្ពុជាចំពោះការបន្តផ្សព្វផ្សាយព័ត៌មាន 'តែម្ខាង' ទៅកាន់សាធារណជន។ ថៃអះអាងថាខ្លួនកំពុងអនុវត្តតាមសេចក្តីថ្លែងការណ៍រួមដោយរក្សាតំណែងទ័ព និងបោសសម្អាតមីន។
summaryTh: กองทัพบกสรุปสถานการณ์ 1 เดือนหลังหยุดยิง (27 ธ.ค. 68) ระบุว่าพื้นที่ยังสงบแต่ฝ่ายกัมพูชายังคงให้ข้อมูลบิดเบือนต่อสังคมฝ่ายเดียว โดยเฉพาะเรื่องการวางตู้คอนเทนเนอร์ กองทัพยันทำตามข้อตกลงและมุ่งเน้นการเก็บกู้ทุ่นระเบิดเพื่อความปลอดภัยของประชาชน พร้อมชี้ว่าปัญหาเกิดจากกัมพูชาหนุนคนรุกล้ำอธิปไตยไทยมาโดยตลอด

summary: Army Spokesman Maj. Gen. Winthai Suvaree stated that the situation remains tense due to Cambodia's 'misleading' narratives regarding Thai containers at the border. He explained that these measures are for security and to prevent illegal activities like cyber-scams. Thailand is waiting for Cambodia to show 'sincerity' in demining efforts before proceeding with the next Joint Boundary Commission (JBC) meeting.
summaryKh: អ្នកនាំពាក្យកងទ័ពថៃបានថ្លែងថា ស្ថានភាពនៅតែមានភាពតានតឹងដោយសារតែការផ្សព្វផ្សាយរបស់កម្ពុជាដែល 'នាំឱ្យមានការយល់ច្រឡំ' អំពីទូកុងតឺន័រថៃនៅព្រំដែន។ លោកបានពន្យល់ថា វិធានការទាំងនេះគឺដើម្បីសន្តិសុខ និងបង្ក្រាបសកម្មភាពខុសច្បាប់ដូចជាក្រុមឆបោកតាមប្រព័ន្ធអ៊ីនធឺណិត (scams)។
summaryTh: พล.ต. วินธัย สุวารี โฆษกกองทัพบก ชี้แจงว่าไทยทำตามข้อตกลงหยุดยิงอย่างเคร่งครัด แต่กัมพูชาพยายามสร้างความเข้าใจผิดเรื่องการวางตู้คอนเทนเนอร์ปิดกั้นเส้นทาง ซึ่งแท้จริงแล้วเป็นการป้องกันกิจกรรมผิดกฎหมายและแก๊งสแกมเมอร์ ไทยย้ำว่าต้องเคลียร์ทุ่นระเบิดให้ชัดเจนก่อนจะคุยเรื่องเขตแดนในระดับ JBC ต่อไป
title: Thai Army Denies 'Container Blockade' Claims, Accuses Cambodia of Supporting Sovereignty Encroachment

summary: Cambodian spokesperson Pen Bona issued a strong condemnation of Thai military activities in Oddar Meanchey and Pursat provinces. Cambodia alleges that Thai forces placed shipping containers as blockades and constructed roads inside Cambodian territory, violating the 1904 and 1907 Franco-Siamese treaties. Cambodia maintains that Ta Kwai and Ta Muen temples are under its absolute sovereignty based on the same legal principles as the Preah Vihear case.
summaryKh: អ្នកនាំពាក្យរាជរដ្ឋាភិបាលកម្ពុជា លោក ប៉ែន បូណា បានចេញសេចក្តីថ្លែងការណ៍ថ្កោលទោសយ៉ាងខ្លាំងចំពោះសកម្មភាពយោធាថៃក្នុងខេត្តឧត្តរមានជ័យ និងខេត្តពោធិ៍សាត់។ កម្ពុជាចោទប្រកាន់ថា កងកម្លាំងថៃបានដាក់ទូកុងតឺន័រធ្វើជារបាំង និងសាងសង់ផ្លូវក្នុងទឹកដីកម្ពុជា ដែលរំលោភលើសន្ធិសញ្ញាឆ្នាំ 1904 និង 1907។

summary: Acting Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has ordered the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Defense to study the legal framework for revoking the 2001 Memorandum of Understanding (MOU 44) regarding the Overlapping Claims Area (OCA) in the Gulf of Thailand. The government stated that maintaining the agreement provides no benefit and cited the need to wait for the Election Commission's certification of the 2026 election results before a new government fully executes the move.

summary: Thai media is highlighting reports from Cambodia where academic analysts suggest that the victory of Anutin Charnvirakul's Bhumjaithai Party in the February 8 election reflects a Thai public desire for military aggression against Cambodia. The report notes that territorial and historical disputes cannot be solved by elections alone and warns that Cambodia must prepare a multi-generational strategy to defend its sovereignty.

summary: Reporting on Khmer Times' analysis, Thai media highlights Cambodian concerns over the Feb 8 election results. Cambodian analysts suggest that the 194 seats won by Anutin’s Bhumjaithai party, which used nationalist rhetoric during the campaign, show that Thai voters support a hardline stance. There are fears this will lead to increased border tensions and civilian casualties if conflicts remain unresolved.

summary: A Thai private, Pariwat Meemana, was severely injured after stepping on an anti-personnel landmine at Chong Sa-ngam, Phu Sing District, Si Sa Ket province. The blast resulted in the loss of his lower left leg and shrapnel wounds to his right leg. This area has been a flashpoint for recent tensions. Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul acknowledged the incident, stating the mines are old remnants from previous occupations. Local traders are terrified that this will trigger a 'third round' of armed clashes.

summary: Recent international reports shared by Thai media reveal the inner workings of Chinese-run scam centers in Cambodia that have finally been shut down. Investigators found 'scripts' specifically designed to target Thai citizens. While Cambodian authorities have ramped up crackdowns recently, the report notes that past efforts were often seen as insufficient, and the current campaign aims to arrest high-level ringleaders to reduce regional friction.

summary: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul authorized the military to reinforce border fences and modernize weaponry following an incident where a Thai soldier stepped on a landmine in Sisaket province on February 11. He clarified that the incident was not a clash but emphasized the need for security. Additionally, he stated that the 2001 MOU on overlapping maritime claims could be canceled via a Cabinet resolution without requiring parliamentary approval.
summaryKh: នាយករដ្ឋមន្ត្រី Anutin Charnvirakul បានអនុញ្ញាតឱ្យកងទ័ពពង្រឹងរបងព្រំដែន និងបង្កើនអាវុធយុទ្ធភណ្ឌ បន្ទាប់ពីមានហេតុការណ៍ទាហានថៃជាន់មីននៅខេត្តស៊ីសាកេត កាលពីថ្ងៃទី 11 ខែកុម្ភៈ។ លោកបានបញ្ជាក់ថា នេះមិនមែនជាការប៉ះទង្គិចគ្នាទេ ប៉ុន្តែត្រូវតែបង្កើនសុវត្ថិភាព។ ក្រៅពីនេះ លោកក៏បានលើកឡើងថា ការលុបចោល MOU ឆ្នាំ 2001 ស្តីពីតំបន់សមុទ្រត្រួតស៊ីគ្នា អាចធ្វើឡើងតាមរយៈសេចក្តីសម្រេចរបស់គណៈរដ្ឋមន្ត្រី ដោយមិនចាំបាច់ឆ្លងកាត់សភាឡើយ។
summaryTh: นายกฯ อนุทิน ชาญวีรกูล อนุมัติให้กองทัพเสริมแนวรั้วชายแดนและเพิ่มอาวุธยุทโธปกรณ์ หลังเกิดเหตุทหารไทยเหยียบทุ่นระเบิดที่ จ.ศรีสะเกษ เมื่อวันที่ 11 ก.พ. โดยย้ำว่าไม่ใช่การปะทะแต่ต้องเพิ่มความปลอดภัย นอกจากนี้ยังระบุว่าการยกเลิก MOU 2544 เรื่องพื้นที่ทับซ้อนทางทะเลสามารถทำได้ผ่านมติ ครม. โดยไม่ต้องผ่านสภา

summary: Following the 2025 border conflict and trade disruptions, Cambodia is drastically reducing its economic reliance on Thailand. Imports of essential goods, particularly fuel which previously came 90% from Thailand, are now being rerouted through Vietnam and China. This strategic shift has caused logistics costs to rise by 25-40%, but is seen as a move toward strategic independence from Thailand.

summary: The Royal Thai Navy addressed reports that the Cambodian Navy seized a Thai vessel, 'Ko Chok Burapha,' near Koh Kong on February 14. summary: The Secretary-General of the Council of State, Pakorn Nilprapunt, stated that the Ministry of Foreign Affairs must lead the study on canceling MOU 2544 regarding overlapping maritime areas. This follows an order from PM Anutin Charnvirakul. The legal move is seen as a push for national sovereignty after recent border clashes, though it requires careful consideration of international law.

However, Thailand expressed concern over Cambodia's continued 'provocations' and the spreading of false information in international forums, alleging Thai occupation of Cambodian land.

summary: Thailand's Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow is shifting the diplomatic narrative by highlighting the global impact of online scams operating out of Cambodia. This comes as Cambodia deploys nearly 10,000 troops near Hill 745 in Ubon Ratchathani. Thailand plans to take these issues to the UN Human Rights Council in Geneva to counter Cambodia's accusations of territorial violations.

summary: The Thai Ministry of Foreign Affairs clarified that the Joint Boundary Commission (JBC) meetings will proceed once the new Thai cabinet is settled after the February 8 elections. Thailand officially expressed concern over 'distorted' claims by PM Hun Manet to international media regarding illegal occupation, asserting that Thailand is strictly following the December 27 ceasefire agreement.

summary: Local reports from Buriram province describe intentional forest fires near the Chong Sai Taku border crossing, allegedly started by Cambodian soldiers. These 'fire rain' sparks are blowing into Thai villages, causing panic among residents who fear the ceasefire might collapse. Local officials have put emergency teams on 24-hour standby and are preparing evacuation plans if the situation escalates.

summary: Thai Army spokesperson Maj Gen Winthai Suvaree dismissed accusations made by Cambodian PM Hun Manet in a Reuters interview. The Army claims that the installation of containers and barbed wire are temporary security measures to prevent confrontations, and that Thailand is operating within its own territory according to the December ceasefire agreement. Winthai alleged that Cambodian civilians have been used to provoke Thai forces in the past.

summary: An extraordinary committee from the Senate visited the border areas in Sisaket province to evaluate the pros and cons of canceling the MOUs signed in 2000 and 2001. This follows growing domestic pressure and political promises to scrap the agreements amidst the ongoing maritime and land border disputes.

summary: The Thai Situation Center issued a clarification regarding 'inaccurate' international media reports. It denied claims that Thailand's military response was disproportionate, explaining that the use of F-16 aircraft was a necessary self-defense measure under UN Charter Article 51. The center claimed Cambodian forces initiated attacks on Thai military and civilian areas first, and the Thai airstrikes strictly targeted military positions to protect citizens.

summary: Thai media reports on Cambodian PM Hun Manet's interview with Fox News Digital, where he alleged Thai military advancement into overlapping claim areas has displaced over 80,000 Cambodians. The Thai military has not yet issued a formal counter-statement to these specific international allegations, though the tone in Thai media remains skeptical of the '80,000' figure.

summary: The Thailand-Cambodia Border Defense Command reported 7 heat hotspots/forest fires near the border in Surin and Sisaket provinces. Most fires are on the Cambodian side, some only 500 meters from the Thai border. While the cause is attributed to agricultural burning and foraging, the proximity adds logistical difficulty to the current military standby status in areas like Preah Vihear and Don Tual.

summary: The Royal Thai Armed Forces have officially released a white paper containing maps and historical evidence to justify Thai troop positions. This moves the conflict into a legal and diplomatic documentation phase, aiming to rebut PM Hun Manet's claims of 'nasty war' and territorial theft presented during his recent visit to the U.S.

summary: Army Region 2 spokesperson addressed reports from Cambodian media (TFA/Khmer) claiming Thai troops opened fire at Chong An Ma, injuring a Cambodian soldier. Thailand insists no weapons were used; instead, Thai troops only gave verbal warnings to Cambodian forces moving too close to Thai lines. A Cambodian soldier was reportedly injured by 5-7 shots from an unknown source within Cambodia, and Thailand urges both sides to stick to the GBC ceasefire guidelines.

summary: Reports suggest a possible 'setup' by Cambodian forces after they claimed a soldier was wounded by Thai fire at Chong An Ma. Thai security sources argue the wound appears inconsistent with a bullet strike, possibly being a scratch or cut instead. The report emphasizes adhering to the ceasefire and GBC agreements despite these accusations.

summary: Two Cambodian journalists, Phorn Sopheap and Pheap Pheara, are appealing their 14-year prison sentences for treason. They were convicted in December 2025 for posting Facebook photos of border clashes with Thailand, which allegedly included images of land mines. International rights groups have condemned the sentences as a suppression of press freedom.

summary: Thai security agencies responded to Cambodian claims that a soldier was shot from the Thai side at Chong An Ma on February 20. Experts noted that photographs of the soldier's knee injury do not align with forensic patterns of gunshot wounds in terms of shape, size, or surrounding tissue. Authorities urged both sides to follow the GBC (General Border Committee) framework to maintain stability.

summary: Thai military units reported an exchange of fire with Cambodian forces in the Phan Hin Paed Kon area of Sisaket province. The incident reportedly began when Cambodian troops fired a 40mm grenade (M79) at a Thai patrol, prompting Thai soldiers to return fire. No Thai casualties were reported, and the situation has since calmed, though troops remain on high alert. The Thai military suggests the incident may have been caused by a lack of coordination during a Cambodian troop rotation.

summary: Foreign Affairs Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow stated that Cambodia's leadership continues to use 'old tactics' of fabricating news to pressure Thailand on the global stage. He revealed that he recently met with UNESCO's Director-General to clarify that Thailand did not intend to damage the Preah Vihear Temple, blaming the damage on Cambodia using the site as a military base and weapons cache. Thailand maintains a stance of restraint while seeking to rebuild mutual trust.

summary: Thai Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow delivered a statement at the UN Human Rights Council in Geneva, rejecting Cambodia's accusations of territorial encroachment. He described Cambodia's narrative as distorted and 'demonizing' Thailand. Sihasak emphasized that Thailand remains committed to the December ceasefire and peaceful diplomacy but blamed the recent friction on Cambodian provocations and interference in Thai internal politics.

summary: On the morning of February 24, 2026, a 40mm grenade was fired from the Cambodian side at a Thai patrol in Si Sa Ket's Kantharalak district. Thai forces responded with an M79 warning shot. The Thai military believes the incident was caused by newly rotated Cambodian troops unfamiliar with the area. No injuries were reported, and the Army Chief has ruled out further escalation.
summaryKh: នៅព្រឹកថ្ងៃទី 24 ខែកុម្ភៈ ឆ្នាំ 2026 គ្រាប់បែក 40 មីលីម៉ែត្រត្រូវបានបាញ់ចេញពីភាគីកម្ពុជាមកលើល្បាតថៃក្នុងស្រុក Kantharalak ខេត្ត Si Sa Ket។ កងកម្លាំងថៃបានបាញ់តបវិញជាការព្រមាន។ យោធាថៃជឿថាហេតុការណ៍នេះបណ្តាលមកពីការផ្លាស់ប្តូរទ័ពថ្មីរបស់កម្ពុជា។
summaryTh: เกิดเหตุยิงลูกระเบิดขนาด 40 มม. จากฝั่งกัมพูชาเข้ามายังฐานปฏิบัติการไทยใน อ.กันทรลักษ์ จ.ศรีสะเกษ เมื่อเช้าวันที่ 24 ก.พ. ฝ่ายไทยยิงโต้ตอบเพื่อป้องกันตัว กองทัพคาดว่าสาเหตุมาจากทหารกัมพูชาชุดใหม่ที่เพิ่งผลัดเปลี่ยนกำลังและไม่คุ้นเคยพื้นที่ ยืนยันไม่มีผู้บาดเจ็บและยังไม่ยกระดับความรุนแรง

summary: Tensions flared on Tuesday as Thai military officials reported an exchange of fire in Sisaket province. According to the Thai side, Cambodian forces fired a 40mm grenade round near a Thai patrol unit, leading to a brief retaliatory exchange. No casualties were reported among Thai troops. Cambodia’s Ministry of National Defence subsequently denied using any weapons, calling the reports 'fake news'.

summary: Cambodian Deputy PM and Foreign Minister Prak Sokhonn alleged on the international stage that Thailand has established military bases within Cambodian territory. summary: Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow rejected claims made by Cambodia's Prak Sokhonn at the UN Human Rights Council in Geneva. Cambodia accused Thailand of occupying territory and displacing 650,000 people. Sihasak countered that the 2025 ceasefire is being undermined by Cambodia's "premeditated provocations" and landmines, while Thailand remains committed to defending its sovereignty.

summary: The 'Rak Chart' Party has submitted a petition to UNESCO to investigate Cambodia's registration of traditional wedding ceremonies. The party expresses concern that the attire used in the Cambodian submission is too similar to Thai national dress (Chut Thai), fearing a cultural 'claim' that could mislead the international community. They demand a transparent historical verification of shared or overlapping cultures.

summary: Army Chief Gen Pana Claewplodtook stated that the recent 40mm grenade fired by Cambodian forces into Si Sa Ket originated from a point 100 meters inside Cambodian territory. The Army attributed the incident to a lack of discipline among Cambodian troops. Thailand plans to document the aggression and raise the issue at the UN Human Rights Council while maintaining a restrained military posture to avoid escalation.

summary: The Thai government clarified against reports claiming Thailand used excessive force and cluster munitions. The PRD stated that the use of F-16s was a necessary defensive measure after Cambodian forces used heavy weapons against Thai civilian areas. They denied the use of banned cluster bombs, stating only standard DPICM rounds were used against military targets.

summary: The Cambodian Ministry of Labour reported that remittances from overseas workers dropped from $2.95 billion in 2024 to $1.86 billion in 2025. This sharp decline is attributed to approximately 940,000 Cambodian workers fleeing Thailand due to the ongoing border hostilities. The conflict has forced a massive labor migration back to Cambodia, severely impacting the economy of Cambodian families reliant on Thai wages.

This incident occurred amidst the ongoing 'Thailand-Cambodia Standoff' and highlights the continued danger for personnel operating in contested border zones.

summary: Foreign Affairs Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow, during visits to Paris and Geneva, firmly rejected allegations from Phnom Penh that Thai forces violated Cambodian territory. He reaffirmed Thailand's strict adherence to the December ceasefire and urged Cambodia to use existing bilateral channels rather than international pressure to resolve disputes.

summary: Prime Minister Srettha Thavisin met with the Army Chief of Staff to discuss border security, stating there is nothing to worry about. Meanwhile, the Royal Thai Navy presented evidence of newly planted landmines in Thai territory (Trat province) to ASEAN observers (AOT), accusing Cambodia of violating sovereignty and obstructing demining efforts.

summaryTh: นายกฯ หารือเสนาธิการทหารบกเกี่ยวกับความมั่นคงชายแดน ยืนยันสถานการณ์ไม่น่ากังวล ในขณะที่กองทัพเรือนำคณะผู้สังเกตการณ์อาเซียน (AOT) ตรวจหลักฐานทุ่นระเบิดใหม่ที่พบในเขตไทย (จ.ตราด) โดยกล่าวหาว่ากัมพูชาลอบเข้ามาวางและขัดขวางการเก็บกู้

summary: Tensions are expected to rise as the Thai administration prepares to scrap MOU 44, the 2001 agreement regarding overlapping maritime claims in the Gulf of Thailand. The move comes as Cambodia continues a 'three-front campaign' involving border pressure, international diplomacy, and information warfare. The Royal Thai Army has also warned it will strike deep into Cambodian territory if PHL-03 rocket launchers are used against Thailand.
summaryKh: ភាពតានតឹងត្រូវបានរំពឹងថានឹងកើនឡើង ខណៈដែលរដ្ឋបាលថៃត្រៀមលុបចោល MOU 44 ដែលជាកិច្ចព្រមព្រៀងឆ្នាំ 2001 ស្តីពីការទាមទារដែនសមុទ្រត្រួតស៊ីគ្នាក្នុងឈូងសមុទ្រថៃ។ ចលនានេះកើតឡើងខណៈកម្ពុជាបន្ត 'យុទ្ធនាការបីរណសិរ្ស' រួមមានសម្ពាធព្រំដែន ការទូតអន្តរជាតិ និងសង្គ្រាមព័ត៌មាន។ កងទ័ពភូមិន្ទថៃក៏បានព្រមានថានឹងវាយប្រហារយ៉ាងជ្រៅទៅក្នុងទឹកដីកម្ពុជា ប្រសិនបើឧបករណ៍បាញ់រ៉ុក្កែត PHL-03 ត្រូវបានប្រើប្រាស់ប្រឆាំងនឹងប្រទេសថៃ។
summaryTh: คาดการณ์ความตึงเครียดจะพุ่งสูงขึ้นเนื่องจากรัฐบาลไทยเตรียมยกเลิก MOU 44 ซึ่งเป็นข้อตกลงปี 2544 เกี่ยวกับพื้นที่อ้างสิทธิทางทะเลทับซ้อนในอ่าวไทย ความเคลื่อนไหวนี้เกิดขึ้นในขณะที่กัมพูชายังคงดำเนินกลยุทธ์กดดันไทยในสามด้าน คือ พื้นที่ชายแดน เวทีการทูตระหว่างประเทศ และสงครามข้อมูลข่าวสาร ด้านกองทัพบกไทยเตือนพร้อมยิงโต้ตอบลึกเข้าไปในกัมพูชาหากมีการใช้จรวด PHL-03 โจมตีไทย

summary: Reports from the Joint Information Center and military social media groups indicate that Cambodia is moving at least 4-5 companies of newly trained soldiers and artillery units to the 'front line' as of Feb 28. This mobilization follows a period of clashes in late 2025. Thai authorities are monitoring the situation closely and reinforcing their own defensive positions as Cambodia reportedly fills gaps left by previous casualties.
summaryTh: ศูนย์แถลงข่าวร่วมฯ และสื่อสังคมออนไลน์ของทหารรายงานว่า กัมพูชาเริ่มเคลื่อนกำลังพลทหารใหม่ประมาณ 4-5 กองร้อย พร้อมหน่วยปืนใหญ่เข้าประชิดชายแดนในวันที่ 28 ก.พ. โดยอ้างว่าเป็นคำสั่งจากเบื้องบนเพื่อไปประจำการที่ 'แนวหน้า' หลังจากมีการปะทะกันในช่วงปลายปี 2568 ฝั่งไทยกำลังเฝ้าระวังอย่างใกล้ชิดและเสริมแนวป้องกัน เนื่องจากคาดว่ากัมพูชาต้องการเติมกำลังพลที่สูญเสียไปก่อนหน้านี้

summary: The 45th annual Cobra Gold exercise commenced at U-Tapao with 30 nations participating.
